messages:
Mei (PM): Heads-up: two competing pilot asks landed. One tenant needs tenant-export (logs to S3/syslog) for compliance; another tenant asked for sub-60ms token latency via a low-precision fast-path. We have one eng sprint free. Decision: which to pull into MVP vs push to v1? Need a call for milestone update.

Arun (Eng): Both are orthogonal but each touches infra/runtime. Export is mostly infra plumbing + KMS/ACL checks (~1 sprint). Fast-path touches model runtime, quantization path, perf QA (~1.5 sprints). Can't do both in one sprint safely.

Leah (Sales): Export closes two enterprise pilots — high revenue probability. Fast-path is POC for latency-sensitive startups; nice but not revenue-blocking. Sales recommends export in MVP for pilot tenants.

Tom (SRE): Export increases egress/storage; manageable for single pilots if opt-in and throttled. Fast-path risks GPU saturation spikes; needs canary pools and more aggressive autoscale rules.

Priya (Legal): For export we need a limited DPA addendum and retention defaults. We can fast-track for pilot-only with a short addendum (3 business days). Need product spec before legal drafts.

Mei (PM): Trade: Export -> unlocks paid pilots now. Fast-path -> potential product differentiation later. Proposal: allocate the sprint to tenant-export as MVP pilot-only opt-in, add infra throttles + audit logs, legal-scoped DPA. Fast-path move to v1 backlog with a clear engineering spike this sprint.

Arun (Eng): If export is chosen I'll deliver opt-in export, retention=30d default, rate-limit 10MB/s per tenant, and a kill-switch flag. Will add smoke test for ACLs. Spike for fast-path: 3 days to prototype.

Leah (Sales): I'll secure pilot contracts contingent on "pilot-only export, opt-in, 30d retention". Good call.

Tom (SRE): I'll provision a staging bucket with KMS, add billing meter, and create alert if export throughput >80% provisioned.

roadmap-bot: Milestone updated: "Tenant telemetry export (pilot opt-in)" moved to MVP lane. Owner: Mei. ETA +7 days.

Priya (Legal): Once spec link available I'll prioritize DPA draft.

Mei (PM): Decision recorded: ship tenant-export as MVP pilot-only opt-in with these gates: Legal DPA signed, opt-in default off, infra throttles and billing meter, kill-switch. Fast-path gets a 3-day eng spike and is scheduled for v1 prioritization after spike. I'll update the milestone board and notify execs.

Arun (Eng): Noted. Opening PR for export flags and tests.

Leah (Sales): :thumbsup: will post contract updates here when signed.

Mei (PM): Closing thread unless anyone raises blockers.
